results.final_feedback: Candidate faithfully encodes the conditional fixed-versus-simple frame support determination, preserves declared owners and paths, requires branch-selection values where needed, and requires member-level evidence whenever a support asserts demonstrated rotational restraint.

Retain the ship-owned frameProfileType and plasticCollapseMechanism constraints and the applicable-member/load-case formula checks. Remove gs:SideMemberOrientationI2_031Shape: it incorrectly makes transverseFrameOrientation=true mandatory for every side-structure member, whereas only side members explicitly selected as transverse are applicable; missing side orientation must not select that member or be converted into a universal side-member obligation. Also add the declared COMPLETE formula operand nltl:patchLoad on its authoritative owner ship, with its QUDT QuantityValue decimal numeric value and canonical KiloN unit; do not relocate it to a member or load case.

Correct the bending-moment unit conversion: nltl:webFrameIceLoad is constrained in kN while the verified formula requires F in MN, so bind expected M as 0.193*(?force * 0.001)*?span (equivalently 0.000193*?force*?span) in MN·m before the Z calculation. Also replace the three multi-binding SPARQL constraints with one bounded formula constraint that reports zero/non-real denominator and formula mismatches, while retaining SHACL Core operand, unit, table-reference, and evidence constraints; the current separate unbounded joins are combinatorial.
